5fc21f8ae0.why: Both limb subtractions and stores are required, and ADC must incorporate the final borrow into the live EAX result.

2e7ac64433.why: The third-limb load, three chained subtractions, three stores, and final borrow extraction all contribute to required results.

e149e99437.why: The pointer updates and four stored differences are required, while INC followed by DEC zero-extends EAX and sets ZF from its unchanged value without disturbing the subtraction chain's CF.

86ecd5bff3.why: Both NOR results and stores are needed, and packing the mixed register and memory inputs plus safely loading unaligned data prevents an SSE2 instruction-count reduction.

56f8d89a63.why: The second input's complement and both XOR results must reach their stores, and neither SSE2 packing nor the required RCX and CF update removes an instruction.
